description:
Bring your own bucket from any S3-compatible provider (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, and more). The gateway authenticates each call with your svcpass key, resolves which upstream bucket to reach, and returns a presigned redirect URL — clients then fetch the bytes directly from your upstream storage, so the gateway never moves the object and takes no commission on it.

Two channels are available. The free `byok` channel relays one bucket you store once as customer secrets (`S3_RELAY_*`), reached at the canonical `…/s3-relay` gateway address. The metered `plus` channel ($0.001/request relayed) lets you run many buckets under one account — each enrollment binds its own bucket/endpoint/credentials and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for full setup of both channels.
name: s3-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own storage

summary: Serve objects from your own S3-compatible storage through the UnitySVC gateway, which returns presigned redirect URLs so clients download directly from your bucket.
